// ─── Inventory ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

enum InventoryReason {
  sale
  return_
  adjust
  restock
  transfer
  damage
}

model InventoryMovement {
  id        String          @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  productId String          @map("product_id") @db.Uuid
  variantId String?         @map("variant_id") @db.Uuid
  delta     Int             // + restock, - sale
  reason    InventoryReason
  note      String?
  actorId   String?         @map("actor_id") @db.Uuid
  orderId   String?         @map("order_id") @db.Uuid
  createdAt DateTime        @default(now()) @map("created_at")

  product Product         @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id])
  variant ProductVariant? @relation(fields: [variantId], references: [id])

  @@index([productId, createdAt])
  @@map("inventory_movements")
}

// ─── Customers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

model Customer {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  email     String?  @db.Citext
  phone     String?
  name      String
  dob       DateTime? @db.Date
  tags      String[] @default([])
  notes     String?
  metadata  Json?
  deletedAt DateTime? @map("deleted_at")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  addresses CustomerAddress[]
  orders    Order[]

  @@unique([email])
  @@index([phone])
  @@map("customers")
}

model CustomerAddress {
  id         String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  customerId String   @map("customer_id") @db.Uuid
  fullName   String   @map("full_name")
  phone      String
  line1      String
  ward       String?
  district   String?
  province   String
  postalCode String?  @map("postal_code")
  isDefault  Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_default")
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")

  customer Customer @relation(fields: [customerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([customerId])
  @@map("customer_addresses")
}

// ─── Orders ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

enum OrderStatus {
  pending
  confirmed
  packing
  shipping
  delivered
  returned
  cancelled
}

enum PaymentStatus {
  pending
  paid
  refunded
  failed
}

enum PaymentMethod {
  cod
  vnpay
  momo
  bank_transfer
}

model Order {
  id              String        @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  code            String        @unique // DTX-25-00001
  customerId      String?       @map("customer_id") @db.Uuid
  status          OrderStatus   @default(pending)
  paymentStatus   PaymentStatus @default(pending) @map("payment_status")
  paymentMethod   PaymentMethod @map("payment_method")
  subtotal        BigInt
  discountTotal   BigInt        @default(0) @map("discount_total")
  shippingFee     BigInt        @default(0) @map("shipping_fee")
  tax             BigInt        @default(0)
  total           BigInt
  shippingAddress Json          @map("shipping_address")
  billingAddress  Json?         @map("billing_address")
  notes           String?
  voucherCode     String?       @map("voucher_code")
  placedAt        DateTime      @default(now()) @map("placed_at")
  paidAt          DateTime?     @map("paid_at")
  shippedAt       DateTime?     @map("shipped_at")
  deliveredAt     DateTime?     @map("delivered_at")
  cancelledAt     DateTime?     @map("cancelled_at")
  createdAt       DateTime      @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt       DateTime      @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  customer Customer?   @relation(fields: [customerId], references: [id])
  items    OrderItem[]
  events   OrderEvent[]

  @@index([status])
  @@index([customerId])
  @@index([placedAt])
  @@map("orders")
}

model OrderItem {
  id         String @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  orderId    String @map("order_id") @db.Uuid
  productId  String @map("product_id") @db.Uuid
  variantId  String? @map("variant_id") @db.Uuid
  nameSnapshot String @map("name_snapshot")
  priceUnit  BigInt @map("price_unit")
  qty        Int
  subtotal   BigInt

  order   Order           @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  variant ProductVariant? @relation(fields: [variantId], references: [id])

  @@index([orderId])
  @@map("order_items")
}

model OrderEvent {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  orderId   String   @map("order_id") @db.Uuid
  kind      String   // status_change, note, payment, shipping
  fromState String?  @map("from_state")
  toState   String?  @map("to_state")
  actorId   String?  @map("actor_id") @db.Uuid
  note      String?
  metadata  Json?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")

  order Order @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([orderId, createdAt])
  @@map("order_events")
}

// ─── Audit log ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

model AuditLog {
  id         BigInt   @id @default(autoincrement())
  at         DateTime @default(now())
  actorId    String?  @map("actor_id") @db.Uuid
  actorEmail String?  @map("actor_email")
  actorIp    String?  @map("actor_ip")
  userAgent  String?  @map("user_agent")
  action     String   // product.update, auth.login.success, ...
  entity     String?
  entityId   String?  @map("entity_id")

// ─── Vouchers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

enum VoucherType {
  percent
  amount
  shipping
}

enum VoucherStatus {
  active
  scheduled
  paused
  expired
}

model Voucher {
  id          String        @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  code        String        @unique
  type        VoucherType
  value       BigInt        @default(0) // % hoặc số tiền VND
  minOrder    BigInt        @default(0) @map("min_order")
  startAt     DateTime?     @map("start_at")
  endAt       DateTime?     @map("end_at")
  usageLimit  Int?          @map("usage_limit")
  usedCount   Int           @default(0) @map("used_count")
  status      VoucherStatus @default(active)
  description String?
  createdAt   DateTime      @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt   DateTime      @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  @@index([status])
  @@map("vouchers")
}

// ─── Articles (journal) ─────────────────────────────────────────

enum ArticleStatus {
  draft
  scheduled
  published
  archived
}

model Article {
  id          String        @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  slug        String        @unique
  title       String
  author      String?
  category    String?
  excerpt     String?
  body        String        @default("")
  coverUrl    String?       @map("cover_url")
  tags        String[]      @default([])
  status      ArticleStatus @default(draft)
  views       Int           @default(0)
  seoTitle    String?       @map("seo_title")
  seoDesc     String?       @map("seo_desc")
  publishedAt DateTime?     @map("published_at")
  createdAt   DateTime      @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt   DateTime      @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  @@index([status, publishedAt])
  @@map("articles")
}

// ─── Reviews ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

enum ReviewStatus {
  pending
  approved
  rejected
}

model Review {
  id         String       @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  productId  String       @map("product_id") @db.Uuid
  customerId String?      @map("customer_id") @db.Uuid
  rating     Int          // 1..5
  title      String?
  body       String       @default("")
  status     ReviewStatus @default(pending)
  authorName String       @map("author_name")
  verified   Boolean      @default(false)
  createdAt  DateTime     @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt  DateTime     @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  @@index([productId, status])
  @@map("reviews")
}

// ─── Returns / RMA ──────────────────────────────────────────────

enum ReturnStatus {
  requested
  approved
  rejected
  received
  refunded
  closed
}

model Return {
  id         String       @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  code       String       @unique // RMA-25-0001
  orderId    String       @map("order_id") @db.Uuid
  customerId String?      @map("customer_id") @db.Uuid
  reason     String
  note       String?
  amount     BigInt       @default(0)
  status     ReturnStatus @default(requested)
  createdAt  DateTime     @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt  DateTime     @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  @@index([status, createdAt])
  @@map("returns")
}

// ─── Collections ────────────────────────────────────────────────

model Collection {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  slug        String   @unique
  name        String
  description String?
  coverUrl    String?  @map("cover_url")
  // smart = rule-based (JSON rule), false = manual pins
  isSmart     Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_smart")
  rule        Json?
  productIds  String[] @default([]) @map("product_ids")
  position    Int      @default(0)
  published   Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  @@map("collections")
}

// ─── Settings (singleton KV) ────────────────────────────────────

model AppSetting {
  key       String   @id
  value     Json
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  updatedBy String?  @map("updated_by") @db.Uuid

  @@map("app_settings")
}

Files and Code Sections: **Backend schema addition — `api/prisma/schema.prisma`:** Appended 6 new models + enums at the end: `Voucher`, `Article`, `Review`, `Return`, `Collection`, `AppSetting` with enums `VoucherType {percent,amount,shipping}`, `VoucherStatus`, `ArticleStatus {draft,scheduled,published,archived}`, `ReviewStatus {pending,approved,rejected}`, `ReturnStatus {requested,approved,rejected,received,refunded,closed}`. BigInt for VND values, UUID PKs, indexes on status+date. **Backend routes (all created):** - `api/src/routes/orders.ts` — Order state machine: ```ts const TRANSITIONS: Record = { pending: ['confirmed', 'cancelled'], confirmed: ['packing', 'cancelled'], packing: ['shipping', 'cancelled'], shipping: ['delivered', 'cancelled'], delivered: ['returned'], returned: [], cancelled: [], }; ``` Routes: GET /orders (with filter q/status/paymentStatus/paymentMethod/customerId/date range), GET /orders/:id, POST /orders (computes subtotal + total, creates OrderEvent kind='status_change' toState='pending'), PATCH /orders/:id/status (validates transition, sets shippedAt/deliveredAt/cancelledAt, creates OrderEvent + audit), PATCH /orders/:id/payment (sets paidAt when → 'paid'), POST /orders/:id/events. Uses `nextOrderCode()` generating `DTX-YY-NNNNN` pattern. - `api/src/routes/customers.ts` — CRUD with aggregation: ```ts const agg = await prisma.order.groupBy({ by: ['customerId'], where: { customerId: { in: ids } }, _sum: { total: true }, _count: { _all: true }, }); ``` Soft-delete via `deletedAt`. Post-sort in-memory for spend-desc/orders-desc/name (fetches limit*2 rows then slices). - `api/src/routes/vouchers.ts` — CRUD + `POST /vouchers/validate` returning `{valid, code, type, value, discount, free_shipping}` after checking status=='active', startAt<=now<=endAt, usedCount=minOrder. - `api/src/routes/articles.ts` — CRUD with `ensureUniqueSlug()` appending `-2/-3/...`. Status transition to 'published' auto-sets `publishedAt = new Date()` if null. - `api/src/routes/inventory.ts` — `POST /inventory/adjust` (delta), `POST /inventory/set` (absolute), `POST /inventory/restock-bulk` (increment all variants by qty, optional categoryId filter), `GET /inventory/movements?productId=`. Maps reason enum `return` → `return_` for Prisma (JS keyword clash): ```ts function mapReason(r: string) { return r === 'return' ? 'return_' : (r as any); } ``` - `api/src/routes/settings.ts` — Singleton KV, key='app'. `scrub()` redacts nested keys in `SECRET_KEYS = ['secret','accessKey','apiKey','token','password']`. `deepMerge()` for PATCH. `GET /settings` (scrubbed, all perm 'settings:read'), `GET /settings/raw` (full, owner only 'settings:write'), `PATCH /settings`, `POST /settings/reset`. - `api/src/routes/reports.ts` — 4 endpoints: - `GET /reports/overview` — orders_7d/30d, gmv_7d/30d, aov, pending_orders, packing_orders, low_stock_skus, customers_total/vip - `GET /reports/revenue?from=&to=&granularity=day|week|month` — bucketed time-series - `GET /reports/top-products?limit=10&from=` — groupBy productId - `GET /reports/customers/cohort` — 6-month cohort retention **Server registration — `api/src/server.ts`:** Added imports and registrations in v1 scope: ```ts import { orderRoutes } from './routes/orders.js'; import { customerRoutes } from './routes/customers.js'; import { voucherRoutes } from './routes/vouchers.js'; import { articleRoutes } from './routes/articles.js'; import { inventoryRoutes } from './routes/inventory.js'; import { settingsRoutes } from './routes/settings.js'; import { reportRoutes } from './routes/reports.js'; // … then in v1.register block await v1.register(orderRoutes); await v1.register(customerRoutes); /* etc */ ``` **Admin API client — `assets/admin-api.js` (new file):** - `request(path, {method,body,params,retry})` wraps fetch with CSRF header on mutations (reads cookie `csrf_token`), credentials:'include', 15s timeout, 401→redirect to `admin-login.html?redirect=...`, 403→toast. - `Api = { get, post, patch, put, del }` shortcuts. - `makeRemoteStore(storeName, basePath, toLocal, toRemote)` factory returning `{all, get, create, update, remove, reset, reload}` matching local makeStore signature; dispatches `dtx:${storeName}-updated` CustomEvent. - Mappers `map.product/order/customer/voucher/article/user/audit.toLocal` convert snake_case API response → camelCase local shape. - Specialized: `makeOrderRemote()` adds `setStatus/setPayment/addEvent`; `makeInventoryRemote()` has `adjust/set/bulkRestock/movements/overview`; `makeSettingsRemote()` has `load/save/reset/defaults`; `makeReportsRemote()` has `overview/revenue/topProducts/cohort`. - When `window.DTX_MODE === 'remote'` installs remote stores overwriting the locally-seeded ones. Default 'local' for backward compatibility. - Local-mode `DTX_ADMIN_REPORTS` fallback computes from `DTX_ADMIN_ORDERS.all()` and `DTX_ADMIN.all()`. **admin-products.html modifications:** Prepended script block reading `localStorage.getItem('dtx_mode')` to set `window.DTX_MODE` before loading admin-api.js; added mode banner installer: ```js (function installModeBanner(){ const mode = window.DTX_MODE || 'local'; const b = document.createElement('div'); b.className = 'adm-mode-banner mode-' + mode; b.innerHTML = `Data: ${mode === 'remote' ? 'Remote API' : 'Local (demo)'} `; … b.querySelector('#btnToggleMode').addEventListener('click', () => { const next = mode === 'remote' ? 'local' : 'remote'; localStorage.setItem('dtx_mode', next); location.reload(); }); })(); ``` **admin.css added `.adm-mode-banner`** — fixed bottom-right pill, mode-remote variant uses brand-soft background. **assets/admin-data-ext.js** — appended 3 new domain stores before the `window.DTX_*` assignments: - `seedReviews()` → 32 reviews with ratings 3-5, rotating statuses (pending/approved/rejected), author Vietnamese names - `seedReturns()` → 14 returns with code `RMA-25-NNNN`, reasons array, amount, rotating statuses - `seedCollections()` → 5 collections (best-sellers smart/sort:sales, new-arrivals smart/newWithin:30, vegan smart/tag:vegan, ritual-am manual, gift-set manual unpublished) - Each via `makeStore()` with proper `normalize` functions - Exposed as `window.DTX_ADMIN_REVIEWS`, `window.DTX_ADMIN_RETURNS`, `window.DTX_ADMIN_COLLECTIONS` **admin-reports.html (new):** — 6 KPI cards (orders, GMV, pending, packing, low stock, VIP), range selector (7/30/90d), `#revenueChart` with `.bar-col .bar` CSS bars scaled by max, `#topTbody` for top products, `#statusBars` for order status distribution (labels: pending/confirmed/packing/shipping/delivered/cancelled/returned), CSV export. **admin-reviews.html (new):** — stats (total/pending/approved/rejected/avg star), filters (q/status/rating), review-card layout with avatar-sm + verified chip + `.rv-stars` using FA star icons + approve/reject/delete buttons, bulk "duyệt tất cả pending". 4. ## Tóm tắt khối việc vừa hoàn tất

**C3 — `admin-returns.html`** (RMA management):
- 6 stat cards: Tổng / Yêu cầu mới / Đã duyệt / Đã nhận / Hoàn tiền / Tổng hoàn tiền
- Filter: q, trạng thái, sort (mới / cũ / giá trị)
- Bảng `adm-tbl` với state-machine hợp lệ: `requested → approved/rejected`, `approved → received/rejected`, `received → refunded`, `refunded → closed`, `rejected → closed` — nút hành động tự sinh theo NEXT map
- Modal chi tiết `kv` + action buttons; tạo mới nhanh qua prompt; toast + audit qua event

**C4 — `admin-collections.html`** (Smart/Manual collections):
- 5 stat cards + filter (q / kind / publish)
- `col-grid` dạng card: smart hiển thị rule preview (sort/tag/newWithin/limit), manual hiển thị số product
- Nút lên/xuống đổi thứ tự, toggle xuất bản, sửa, xoá
- Modal lớn (`adm-modal-lg`) với form:
  - Rule box (smart): sort / tag / newWithin / limit
  - Pick box (manual): 2 cột — "Đã chọn" (kéo lên/xuống để reorder) vs "Chưa chọn" (tìm kiếm + click `+`)
  - Auto-slugify tên, validate trùng slug
- Bỏ chọn, di chuyển position qua `pill-move`

**C5 — Sidebar + CSS**:
- `admin-shell.js` NAV: `reports` → `admin-reports.html`, `returns` → `admin-returns.html`, `collections` → `admin-collections.html`, `reviews` → `admin-reviews.html`
- Counter động: `returns` (requested+approved+received), `reviews` (pending)
- Thêm listener `dtx:reviews-updated` / `dtx:returns-updated` để auto-refresh badge
- CSS mới (~200 dòng ở cuối `admin.css`): `.chart-bars/.bar-col/.bar`, `.status-bars/.sbar/.sbar-fill.state-*` (màu riêng cho 7 trạng thái đơn), `.review-list/.review-card/.rv-stars`, `.ret-tbl`, `.badge.accent/.info`, `.adm-modal/.adm-modal-card/.kv/.modal-actions`, `.col-grid/.col-card/.col-meta/.col-badges`, `.adm-form/.form-row/.form-actions/.rule-box/.pick-box/.pick-grid/.pick-list/.pill-move`

Toàn bộ dùng CSS variables có sẵn (`--a-brand`, `--a-brand-soft`, `--a-brand-ink`, `--a-shadow-sm/md`, `--a-danger-soft`…) nên tương thích dark mode tự động.

enum PaymentStatus {
  pending
  paid
  refunded
  failed
}

enum PaymentMethod {
  cod
  vnpay
  momo
  bank_transfer
}

model Order {
  id              String        @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  code            String        @unique // DTX-25-00001
  customerId      String?       @map("customer_id") @db.Uuid
  status          OrderStatus   @default(pending)
  paymentStatus   PaymentStatus @default(pending) @map("payment_status")
  paymentMethod   PaymentMethod @map("payment_method")
  subtotal        BigInt
  discountTotal   BigInt        @default(0) @map("discount_total")
  shippingFee     BigInt        @default(0) @map("shipping_fee")
  tax             BigInt        @default(0)
  total           BigInt
  shippingAddress Json          @map("shipping_address")
  billingAddress  Json?         @map("billing_address")
  notes           String?
  voucherCode     String?       @map("voucher_code")
  placedAt        DateTime      @default(now()) @map("placed_at")
  paidAt          DateTime?     @map("paid_at")
  shippedAt       DateTime?     @map("shipped_at")
  deliveredAt     DateTime?     @map("delivered_at")
  cancelledAt     DateTime?     @map("cancelled_at")
  createdAt       DateTime      @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt       DateTime      @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  customer Customer?   @relation(fields: [customerId], references: [id])
  items    OrderItem[]
  events   OrderEvent[]

  @@index([status])
  @@index([customerId])
  @@index([placedAt])
  @@map("orders")
}

model OrderItem {
  id         String @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  orderId    String @map("order_id") @db.Uuid
  productId  String @map("product_id") @db.Uuid
  variantId  String? @map("variant_id") @db.Uuid
  nameSnapshot String @map("name_snapshot")
  priceUnit  BigInt @map("price_unit")
  qty        Int
  subtotal   BigInt

  order   Order           @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  variant ProductVariant? @relation(fields: [variantId], references: [id])

  @@index([orderId])
  @@map("order_items")
}

model OrderEvent {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  orderId   String   @map("order_id") @db.Uuid
  kind      String   // status_change, note, payment, shipping
  fromState String?  @map("from_state")
  toState   String?  @map("to_state")
  actorId   String?  @map("actor_id") @db.Uuid
  note      String?
  metadata  Json?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")

  order Order @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([orderId, createdAt])
  @@map("order_events")
}

// ─── Payments ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

enum PaymentProvider {
  manual        // COD, bank_transfer xác nhận thủ công
  vnpay
  momo
  stripe
}

enum PaymentIntentStatus {
  created
  pending
  succeeded
  failed
  cancelled
  refunded
}

/// Giao dịch thanh toán — 1 order có thể có >1 payment (COD thất bại → chuyển VNPay)
model Payment {
  id             String              @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  orderId        String              @map("order_id") @db.Uuid
  provider       PaymentProvider
  providerTxnId  String?             @map("provider_txn_id") // mã giao dịch phía cổng
  amount         BigInt              // VNĐ, >= 0
  currency       String              @default("VND") @db.VarChar(3)
  status         PaymentIntentStatus @default(created)
  returnUrl      String?             @map("return_url")
  /// Redirect URL / QR / deeplink do provider trả về
  redirectUrl    String?             @map("redirect_url")
  rawRequest     Json?               @map("raw_request")
  rawResponse    Json?               @map("raw_response")
  errorCode      String?             @map("error_code")
  errorMessage   String?             @map("error_message")
  idempotencyKey String?             @unique @map("idempotency_key")
  createdAt      DateTime            @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt      DateTime            @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  paidAt         DateTime?           @map("paid_at")

  events PaymentEvent[]

  @@index([orderId])
  @@index([provider, providerTxnId])
  @@index([status, createdAt])
  @@map("payments")
}

model PaymentEvent {
  id         String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  paymentId  String   @map("payment_id") @db.Uuid
  kind       String   // status_change | webhook | refund | note
  fromStatus String?  @map("from_status")
  toStatus   String?  @map("to_status")
  payload    Json?
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")

  payment Payment @relation(fields: [paymentId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([paymentId, createdAt])
  @@map("payment_events")
}

// ─── Shipping ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

enum ShippingProvider {
  manual
  ghn
  ghtk
  vnpost
}

enum ShipmentStatus {
  created
  ready_to_pick
  picked
  in_transit
  delivered
  failed
  returning
  returned
  cancelled
}

model Shipment {
  id            String           @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  orderId       String           @map("order_id") @db.Uuid
  provider      ShippingProvider
  trackingCode  String?          @unique @map("tracking_code")
  status        ShipmentStatus   @default(created)
  shippingFee   BigInt           @default(0) @map("shipping_fee")
  weightGram    Int?             @map("weight_gram")
  lengthCm      Int?             @map("length_cm")
  widthCm       Int?             @map("width_cm")
  heightCm      Int?             @map("height_cm")
  pickupAddress Json?            @map("pickup_address")
  shipAddress   Json             @map("ship_address")
  labelUrl      String?          @map("label_url")
  rawResponse   Json?            @map("raw_response")
  errorCode     String?          @map("error_code")
  errorMessage  String?          @map("error_message")
  pickedAt      DateTime?        @map("picked_at")
  deliveredAt   DateTime?        @map("delivered_at")
  createdAt     DateTime         @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt     DateTime         @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  events ShipmentEvent[]

  @@index([orderId])
  @@index([provider, trackingCode])
  @@index([status, createdAt])
  @@map("shipments")
}

model ShipmentEvent {
  id         String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  shipmentId String   @map("shipment_id") @db.Uuid
  kind       String   // status_change | webhook | location | note
  fromStatus String?  @map("from_status")
  toStatus   String?  @map("to_status")
  location   String?
  payload    Json?
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")

  shipment Shipment @relation(fields: [shipmentId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([shipmentId, createdAt])
  @@map("shipment_events")
}

// ─── Email queue (BullMQ source of truth mirror) ────────────────

enum EmailJobStatus {
  queued
  sending
  sent
  failed
  skipped
}

/// Audit/outbox cho mỗi email đã đẩy vào queue — để UI thấy được lịch sử & retry
model EmailJob {
  id           String         @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  template     String         // order.confirmation | order.status | auth.reset | ...
  toEmail      String         @map("to_email")
  toName       String?        @map("to_name")
  subject      String
  data         Json?          // biến render
  status       EmailJobStatus @default(queued)
  provider     String?        // ses | resend | mailhog | console
  providerId   String?        @map("provider_id")
  attempt      Int            @default(0)
  lastError    String?        @map("last_error")
  scheduledAt  DateTime?      @map("scheduled_at")
  sentAt       DateTime?      @map("sent_at")
  createdAt    DateTime       @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt    DateTime       @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  refType      String?        @map("ref_type")   // order | user | ...
  refId        String?        @map("ref_id") @db.Uuid

  @@index([status, createdAt])
  @@index([refType, refId])
  @@index([toEmail, createdAt])
  @@map("email_jobs")
}

  kind       String   // status_change | webhook | location | note
  fromStatus String?  @map("from_status")
  toStatus   String?  @map("to_status")
  location   String?

enum EmailJobStatus {

  sending
  sent
  failed
  skipped

/// Audit/outbox cho mỗi email đã đẩy vào queue — để UI thấy được lịch sử & retry

  toEmail      String         @map("to_email")
  toName       String?        @map("to_name")
  subject      String
  data         Json?          // biến render
  status       EmailJobStatus @default(queued)
  provider     String?        // ses | resend | mailhog | console
  providerId   String?        @map("provider_id")
  attempt      Int            @default(0)
  lastError    String?        @map("last_error")
  scheduledAt  DateTime?      @map("scheduled_at")
  sentAt       DateTime?      @map("sent_at")
  createdAt    DateTime       @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt    DateTime       @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  refType      String?        @map("ref_type")   // order | user | ...
  refId        String?        @map("ref_id") @db.Uuid

  @@index([status, createdAt])
  @@index([refType, refId])
  @@index([toEmail, createdAt])
  @@map("email_jobs")
}

1	/**
2	 * Orders — list, detail, create, update status, add event, cancel.
3	 * State machine: pending → confirmed → packing → shipping → delivered
4	 *                any → cancelled (nếu chưa delivered)
5	 *                delivered → returned (qua flow Returns)
6	 */
7	
8	import type { FastifyPluginAsync } from 'fastify';
9	import { z } from 'zod';
10	import type { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
11	import { prisma } from '../lib/prisma.js';
12	import { writeAudit } from '../lib/audit.js';
13	import { requireAuth, requirePermission } from '../middleware/auth.js';
14	
15	// ─── State machine ──────────────────────────────────────────────
16	
17	const ORDER_STATUSES = ['pending', 'confirmed', 'packing', 'shipping', 'delivered', 'returned', 'cancelled'] as const;
18	type OrderStatus = typeof ORDER_STATUSES[number];
19	
20	const TRANSITIONS: Record<OrderStatus, OrderStatus[]> = {
21	  pending:   ['confirmed', 'cancelled'],
22	  confirmed: ['packing', 'cancelled'],
23	  packing:   ['shipping', 'cancelled'],
24	  shipping:  ['delivered', 'cancelled'],
25	  delivered: ['returned'],
26	  returned:  [],
27	  cancelled: [],
28	};
29	
30	// ─── Schemas ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
31	
32	const ListQuery = z.object({
33	  q:        z.string().max(200).optional(),
34	  status:   z.enum(ORDER_STATUSES).optional(),
35	  paymentStatus: z.enum(['pending', 'paid', 'refunded', 'failed']).optional(),
36	  paymentMethod: z.enum(['cod', 'vnpay', 'momo', 'bank_transfer']).optional(),
37	  customerId: z.string().uuid().optional(),
38	  from: z.coerce.date().optional(),
39	  to:   z.coerce.date().optional(),
40	  sort: z.enum(['placed-desc', 'placed-asc', 'total-desc', 'total-asc']).default('placed-desc'),
41	  page:  z.coerce.number().int().min(1).default(1),
42	  limit: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(100).default(20),
43	});
44	
45	const AddressSchema = z.object({
46	  fullName: z.string().min(1).max(120),
47	  phone:    z.string().min(6).max(20),
48	  line1:    z.string().min(1).max(200),
49	  ward:     z.string().max(100).optional(),
50	  district: z.string().max(100).optional(),
51	  province: z.string().min(1).max(100),
52	  postalCode: z.string().max(20).optional(),
53	}).strict();
54	
55	const OrderItemInput = z.object({
56	  productId: z.string().uuid(),
57	  variantId: z.string().uuid().nullable().optional(),
58	  qty: z.coerce.number().int().positive(),
59	  priceUnit: z.coerce.number().int().nonnegative(), // snapshot
60	  nameSnapshot: z.string().min(1).max(255),
61	}).strict();
62	
63	const OrderCreateBody = z.object({
64	  customerId: z.string().uuid().nullable().optional(),
65	  paymentMethod: z.enum(['cod', 'vnpay', 'momo', 'bank_transfer']),
66	  items: z.array(OrderItemInput).min(1).max(200),
67	  shippingAddress: AddressSchema,
68	  billingAddress: AddressSchema.optional(),
69	  voucherCode: z.string().max(30).nullable().optional(),
70	  discountTotal: z.coerce.number().int().nonnegative().default(0),
71	  shippingFee: z.coerce.number().int().nonnegative().default(0),
72	  tax: z.coerce.number().int().nonnegative().default(0),
73	  notes: z.string().max(1000).nullable().optional(),
74	}).strict();
75	
76	const StatusUpdateBody = z.object({
77	  status: z.enum(ORDER_STATUSES),
78	  note: z.string().max(500).optional(),
79	}).strict();

content.text:
---

## REPORT: DETOXBLANC INVENTORY MODULE ANALYSIS

### 1. Prisma Entities Hiện Có

| Entity | Fields Chính | Unique/Index | Relations |
|--------|-------------|-------------|-----------|
| **Product** | id, code (unique), stock, lowStockThreshold, categoryId | status+deletedAt idx, categoryId idx | variants (1-N), movements (1-N) |
| **ProductVariant** | id, productId, skuSuffix, stock, lowStockThreshold | (productId+skuSuffix) unique | product, movements (1-N), orderItems |
| **InventoryMovement** | id, productId, variantId, delta, reason, note, actorId, orderId | (productId+createdAt) idx | product, variant |
| **InventoryReason** enum | sale, return_, adjust, restock, transfer, damage | — | — |

**Nhận xét:** Chỉ có 4 entity liên quan inventory. Không có Warehouse, StockLot, ExpiryDate, Reservation/Allocation.

---

### 2. Backend Endpoints Hiện Có

| Method | Endpoint | Action |
|--------|----------|--------|
| GET | `/inventory` | Lấy overview tồn kho tất cả SKU (với filter q/state/category + pagination) |
| POST | `/inventory/adjust` | Điều chỉnh ±delta (sale/return/adjust/restock/transfer/damage) + ghi InventoryMovement |
| POST | `/inventory/set` | Set tồn kho thành giá trị cụ thể |
| POST | `/inventory/restock-bulk` | Cộng N lượng cho tất cả variants (hoặc theo category) |
| GET | `/inventory/movements` | Lấy lịch sử movements (audit trail) |

**Nhận xét:** 5 endpoints, chủ yếu là adjust/read. Không có transfer, physical count reconciliation, lot/expiry management, multi-warehouse.

---

### 3. Frontend Features Hiện Có

**Dashboard Stats:**
- Tổng SKU, Hết hàng, Thấp ngưỡng, Tổng số lượng

**Filter/Search:**
- Input search (SKU + tên sản phẩm)
- Select trạng thái (Hết hàng / Thấp ngưỡng / Còn hàng / Tất cả)
- Select danh mục

**Table:**
- SKU, Sản phẩm, Danh mục, Ngưỡng, Tồn, Trạng thái, Điều chỉnh (+/- button, input, Set button)

**Actions:**
- Xuất tồn kho (CSV)
- Nhập kho hàng loạt (bulk +N)

---

### 4. Gaps so với Vận Hành Kho Hàng Thực Tế

| Loại | Gap |
|------|-----|
| **IN (Nhập)** | Chỉ bulk restock. Không có PO (Purchase Order), không ghi nhập từ nhà cung cấp nào, không có số hóa đơn, ngày nhập riêng |
| **OUT (Xuất)** | Xuất tự động khi sale (chưa có), xuất manual. Không ghi lý do chi tiết (huỷ/hư/mất/khuyến mại). Không có Batch OUT (xuất từ đơn hàng). |
| **TRANSFER** | Enum có `transfer` nhưng không có endpoint/UI để chuyển giữa kho. Không có Warehouse concept. |
| **ADJUST (Kiểm kê)** | Có adjust manual, nhưng không có Physical Count sheet, không có reconcile (expected vs actual), không có reason code chi tiết. |
| **LOT/Expiry** | Không có InventoryLot entity, không track lô hàng hay HSD. Không FIFO/LIFO. |
| **Multi-warehouse** | Một stock pool duy nhất, không quản lý nhiều kho. |
| **Low-stock alert** | Có threshold nhưng không có notification/alert automation. |
| **Cost of goods** | Product.cost tồn tại nhưng không dùng tính COGS. Không FIFO/avg cost tracking. |
| **Reservation** | Không có reserved_qty khi order pending. Có thể oversell. |

---

### 5. 8 Features Cần Bổ Sung

1. **Warehouse & Location Management** — Add Warehouse model + wareh_location mapping. Support multi-site inventory.

2. **Inventory Lot Tracking** — Create InventoryLot (batchNumber, lotCode, expiryDate, qtyReceived, qtyOnHand, FIFO order). Link ProductVariant → Lots.

3. **Purchase Order (PO) & Receiving** — Add PurchaseOrder + PurchaseOrderLine. Generate IN movement từ receiving GRN (tự động hay manual confirm).

4. **Physical Count & Reconciliation** — InventoryCount entity (countDate, countedBy, reason). Compare expected vs actual → generate adjust movements.

5. **Reservation/Allocation on Order** — Add reserved_qty per variant. Reserve khi order confirmed, release nếu cancel. Dashboard hiển thị Available = OnHand - Reserved.

6. **Detailed Movement Reasons & Codes** — Enum InventoryReasonCode (PO_IN, SALES_OUT, DAMAGE_LOSS, THEFT, EXPIRY_RETURN, PROMO_SAMPLE, TRANSFER_IN, TRANSFER_OUT, COUNT_ADJ_PLUS, COUNT_ADJ_MINUS). Ánh xạ → reason chính.

7. **Stock Movement by Lot (FIFO/LIFO)** — Khi sale → tự động allocate từ lot cũ nhất (FIFO). Ghi LotMovement (lotId, qty, direction).

8. **Automated Low-Stock & Expiry Alerts** — Create Alert entity + Alert Rule (trigger: stock ≤ threshold, expiry ≤ N ngày). Email/notification trigger.

## REPORT: Module Customers — Detoxblanc E-Commerce

### 2. BE Endpoints Hiện Có

Tôi đã đọc toàn bộ module Orders. Dưới đây là report phân tích:

---

## REPORT: DETOXBLANC ORDERS MODULE ANALYSIS

### 1. Prisma Entities Order Hiện Có

**Order model:**
- `id` (UUID, primary)
- `code` (unique, DTX-25-00001 format)
- `customerId` (nullable FK → Customer)
- `status` (enum: pending → confirmed → packing → shipping → delivered → returned / cancelled) 
- `paymentStatus` (enum: pending, paid, refunded, failed)
- `paymentMethod` (enum: cod, vnpay, momo, bank_transfer)
- `subtotal, discountTotal, shippingFee, tax, total` (BigInt — VND)
- `shippingAddress, billingAddress` (JSON)
- `notes, voucherCode` (String)
- `placedAt, paidAt, shippedAt, deliveredAt, cancelledAt` (DateTime)
- Relations: `customer` (O:M), `items` (O:M OrderItem), `events` (O:M OrderEvent)

**OrderItem:**
- `id, orderId, productId, variantId` (uuid)
- `nameSnapshot, qty, priceUnit, subtotal` (price snapshot at order time)

**OrderEvent:**
- `id, orderId, kind, fromState, toState, actorId, note, metadata, createdAt`
- kind: 'status_change', 'note', 'payment', 'shipping'

**Voucher:** 
- type: percent/amount/shipping, value (BigInt), minOrder, startAt/endAt, usageLimit, usedCount, status

---

### 2. BE Endpoints Hiện Có

- **GET /orders** — list (filter q/status/paymentStatus/paymentMethod/customerId/dateRange/sort/paging)
- **GET /orders/:id** — detail with items, events, customer
- **POST /orders** — create (cart → placed, auto-generate code, enqueue confirmation email)
- **PATCH /orders/:id/status** — state change (validate TRANSITIONS, set timestamp, enqueue email)
- **PATCH /orders/:id/payment** — update paymentStatus (pending/paid/refunded/failed)
- **POST /orders/:id/events** — add event (note/payment/shipping/status_change)

**Kiểm tra:** Không có endpoint "POST /orders/admin" hoặc "create-for-customer" — admin tạo thủ công chỉ thông qua JavaScript prompt trên FE.

---

### 3. FE Features Hiện Có

**List View:**
- Filter: search (code/name/phone), status select, payment status, payment method, sort (new/old/value)
- Bulk actions: checkbox select all, change status (confirmed/packing/shipping/cancelled), export CSV
- Stats: pending, packing, shipping, delivered (7d), revenue (7d)

**Detail View (Drawer):**
- Customer info (name, phone, address, notes — read-only)
- Product table (name, qty, priceUnit, subtotal, footer: subtotal/discount/shipping/total)
- Status dropdown + Payment status dropdown → save via JS (call S.update())
- Print slip (open print dialog with order details)

**Gaps:** Không thấy partial fulfill, split, refund UI; admin tạo đơn chỉ có prompt tên+phone+tổng tiền (1 item generic).

---

### 4. Flow Tạo Đơn

**Checkout Public:** 
- POST /orders endpoint kỳ vọng (backend có sẵn, require auth + orders:write permission)
- Không thấy route public; FE chỉ có admin form

**Admin Create:**
- Button "Tạo đơn thủ công" → 3 prompts (name, phone, total)
- Tạo order với 1 item generic "Đơn tạo thủ công"
- Không support: chọn customer cũ, chọn sản phẩm catalog, apply voucher, ship fee

---

### 5. Gap So với Chuẩn POS/OMS

| Gap | Tình Trạng |
|-----|-----------|
| Admin tạo đơn hộ (select KH/tạo mới, select SP, voucher, ship fee, note) | ❌ Chỉ 3 prompt, 1 item generic |
| Partial fulfill (1 đơn → nhiều shipment) | ❌ Không có Shipment model trong Order flow |
| Payment split (cọc + còn lại) | ❌ Không support |
| Refund partial | ❌ Chỉ có paymentStatus, không track refund lines |
| State machine chặt | ✓ Có TRANSITIONS, validate enums, timestamp auto |
| Price snapshot & tax | ✓ Có tax field, price_unit snapshot |
| Gift wrap, shipping option | ❌ Không field nào |
| Quote/Draft order | ❌ Không có |
| Internal vs customer note | ❌ Chỉ 1 notes field chung |
| Shipment model riêng | ✓ Có (nhưng chưa link vào Order flow) |

---

### 6. 10 Feature Cần Bổ Sung

1. **Admin create modal/page:** Select customer (existing/new), add multiple items từ catalog (search + qty), apply voucher code validation, input shipping fee, internal notes, billing address
2. **Partial fulfillment:** Link OrderItem → Shipment (many-to-many), split 1 order thành N shipments, track fulfillment status per item
3. **Payment split:** Add paymentPlans (deposit % → remaining balance), track payment milestones, partial payment capture
4. **Partial refund:** OrderItem-level refund tracking, separate refundedQty, refund reason, linked to Return flow
5. **Customer note vs internal note:** Separate fields (customer_note, internal_note), only customer_note in email/public
6. **Shipping options:** Add shippingMethod field (express/standard/pickup), shippingProvider select, auto-calculate fee
7. **Gift wrap module:** Add giftWrap boolean, giftMessage text, giftWrapFee (BigInt), wrap icon in item display
8. **Quote/Draft order:** OrderStatus include 'quote'/'draft', allow save without confirm, conversion to placed order
9. **Inventory reservation:** Link OrderItem qty to InventoryMovement at status=confirmed, release on cancel, adjust on quantity change
10. **Order fulfillment UI:** Show shipment list per order, update shipment tracking in detail drawer, sync GHN/GHTK webhook events (Shipment model already exists, need orchestration)

---

**Nhận xét:** Hạt nhân state machine & event log tốt, nhưng admin UX rất nguyên thủy, thiếu partial flows & orchestration với Shipment/Payment models đã định nghĩa.

1	// Detoxblanc Admin — Prisma schema
2	// Sync với docs/erd.md. Đổi schema ở đây trước, sau đó cập nhật ERD.
3	
4	generator client {
5	  provider        = "prisma-client-js"
6	  previewFeatures = ["postgresqlExtensions", "fullTextSearchPostgres"]
7	}
8	
9	datasource db {
10	  provider   = "postgresql"
11	  url        = env("DATABASE_URL")
12	  extensions = [pgcrypto, citext, pg_trgm, uuid_ossp(map: "uuid-ossp")]
13	}
14	
15	// ─── Auth & users ───────────────────────────────────────────────
16	
17	enum UserStatus {
18	  active
19	  suspended
20	  deleted
21	}
22	
23	model User {
24	  id              String     @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
25	  email           String     @unique @db.Citext
26	  name            String
27	  passwordHash    String     @map("password_hash")

// Detoxblanc Admin — Prisma schema
// Sync với docs/erd.md. Đổi schema ở đây trước, sau đó cập nhật ERD.

generator client {
  provider        = "prisma-client-js"
  previewFeatures = ["postgresqlExtensions", "fullTextSearchPostgres"]
}

datasource db {
  provider   = "postgresql"
  url        = env("DATABASE_URL")
  extensions = [pgcrypto, citext, pg_trgm, uuid_ossp(map: "uuid-ossp")]
}

// ─── Auth & users ───────────────────────────────────────────────

enum UserStatus {
  active
  suspended
  deleted
}

model User {
  id              String     @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  email           String     @unique @db.Citext
  name            String
  passwordHash    String     @map("password_hash")
  totpSecretEnc   String?    @map("totp_secret_enc")
  totpEnabled     Boolean    @default(false) @map("totp_enabled")
  avatarUrl       String?    @map("avatar_url")
  status          UserStatus @default(active)
  lockedUntil     DateTime?  @map("locked_until")
  lastLoginAt     DateTime?  @map("last_login_at")
  lastLoginIp     String?    @map("last_login_ip")
  failedLogins    Int        @default(0) @map("failed_logins")
  passwordChangedAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("password_changed_at")
  createdAt       DateTime   @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt       DateTime   @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  sessions      Session[]
  roles         UserRole[]
  backupCodes   BackupCode[]
  auditLogs     AuditLog[]

  @@index([status])
  @@map("users")
}

model Session {
  id         String   @id @default(dbgenerated("gen_random_uuid()")) @db.Uuid
  userId     String   @map("user_id") @db.Uuid
  ip         String?
  userAgent  String?  @map("user_agent")
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  expiresAt  DateTime @map("expires_at")
  revokedAt  DateTime? @map("revoked_at")
  lastSeenAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("last_seen_at")

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([expiresAt])
  @@map("sessions")
}

model BackupCode {
  id        String    @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  userId    String    @map("user_id") @db.Uuid
  codeHash  String    @map("code_hash")
  usedAt    DateTime? @map("used_at")
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
  @@map("backup_codes")
}

// ─── RBAC ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  order   Order           @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  variant ProductVariant? @relation(fields: [variantId], references: [id])

  @@index([orderId])
  @@map("order_items")
}

model OrderEvent {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  orderId   String   @map("order_id") @db.Uuid
  kind      String   // status_change, note, payment, shipping
  fromState String?  @map("from_state")
  toState   String?  @map("to_state")
  actorId   String?  @map("actor_id") @db.Uuid
  note      String?
  metadata  Json?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")

  order Order @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([orderId, createdAt])
  @@map("order_events")
}

// ─── Audit log ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

model AuditLog {
  id         BigInt   @id @default(autoincrement())
  at         DateTime @default(now())
  actorId    String?  @map("actor_id") @db.Uuid
  actorEmail String?  @map("actor_email")
  actorIp    String?  @map("actor_ip")
  userAgent  String?  @map("user_agent")
  action     String   // product.update, auth.login.success, ...
  entity     String?
  entityId   String?  @map("entity_id")
  diff       Json?
  requestId  String?  @map("request_id")
  prevHash   String?  @map("prev_hash")
  hash       String?

  user User? @relation(fields: [actorId], references: [id])

  @@index([actorId])
  @@index([entity, entityId])
  @@index([action, at])
  @@map("audit_logs")
}

// ─── Vouchers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

enum VoucherType {
  percent
  amount
  shipping
}

enum VoucherStatus {
  active
  scheduled
  paused
  expired
}

model Voucher {
  id          String        @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  code        String        @unique
  type        VoucherType
  value       BigInt        @default(0) // % hoặc số tiền VND
  minOrder    BigInt        @default(0) @map("min_order")
  startAt     DateTime?     @map("start_at")
  endAt       DateTime?     @map("end_at")
  usageLimit  Int?          @map("usage_limit")
  usedCount   Int           @default(0) @map("used_count")
  status      VoucherStatus @default(active)
  description String?
  createdAt   DateTime      @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt   DateTime      @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  @@index([status])
  @@map("vouchers")
}

// ─── Articles (journal) ─────────────────────────────────────────

enum ArticleStatus {
  draft
  scheduled
  published
  archived
}

enum LoyaltyTier {
  bronze
  silver
  gold
  platinum
}

enum CustomerSegment {
  new_cus           // < 30 ngày, 0-1 order
  active
  vip               // top 5% spend
  at_risk           // Không mua > 60 ngày
  churn             // Không mua > 180 ngày
  blacklist         // Chặn (bom hàng, fraud)
}

model Customer {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  email     String?  @db.Citext
  phone     String?
  name      String
  dob       DateTime? @db.Date
  gender    String?   // male | female | other
  tags      String[] @default([])
  notes     String?

  // Marketing consent
  consentEmail      Boolean   @default(false) @map("consent_email")
  consentSms        Boolean   @default(false) @map("consent_sms")
  consentCall       Boolean   @default(true)  @map("consent_call")
  consentUpdatedAt  DateTime? @map("consent_updated_at")

  // Loyalty (denormalized — tính lại qua recomputeLoyalty)
  loyaltyTier   LoyaltyTier     @default(bronze) @map("loyalty_tier")
  loyaltyPoints Int             @default(0)      @map("loyalty_points")
  totalSpent    BigInt          @default(0)      @map("total_spent")
  orderCount    Int             @default(0)      @map("order_count")
  lastOrderAt   DateTime?       @map("last_order_at")
  segment       CustomerSegment @default(new_cus)

  // Acquisition
  source     String?   // fb | google | offline | referral | organic | tiktok

  metadata  Json?
  deletedAt DateTime? @map("deleted_at")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  addresses      CustomerAddress[]
  orders         Order[]
  communications CustomerCommunication[]

  @@unique([email])
  @@index([phone])
  @@index([segment])
  @@index([loyaltyTier])
  @@map("customers")
}

model CustomerAddress {
  id             String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  customerId     String   @map("customer_id") @db.Uuid
  label          String?  // "Nhà riêng" | "Công ty"
  fullName       String   @map("full_name")
  phone          String

This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   - **Previous session (completed):** P0 TypeScript fixes for payments/shipping services + session summary.
   - **"gửi link demo local"** — Serve local demo, provide URLs for FE + BE.
   - **"hoàn thiện tính năng chuẩn logic nhận của chuyên gia vận hành quản trị: kho hàng, khách hàng, lên đơn"** — The main task: complete features for 3 operational modules (Inventory, Customers, Order Creation) per real operations expert standards. This is the active work being done.
   - Auto Mode is active — execute autonomously, prefer action over planning.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - Fastify 5 + Prisma 6 + PostgreSQL 16 + Redis (Valkey) + BullMQ 5
   - E-commerce OMS (Order Management System) / POS patterns
   - Inventory reservation/allocation model (stock / reserved / available)
   - Moving-average cost accounting (avgCost per variant updated on receive)
   - Purchase Order (PO) / Goods Receiving Note flow
   - Physical count reconciliation
   - RFM segmentation (Recency/Frequency/Monetary) → auto-tag VIP/at_risk/churn
   - Loyalty tier computation (bronze/silver/gold/platinum by totalSpent)
   - Loyalty points: 1pt/10k VND earn, 1pt=1k VND redeem, max 20% order total
   - Marketing consent (email/SMS/call opt-in) with audit trail
   - Communication log (email/SMS/call/chat/note timeline per customer)
   - Customer merge (primary ← secondary consolidation)
   - Customer CSV import (upsert by email/phone)
   - Order state machine: draft → quote → pending → confirmed → packing → shipping → delivered
   - Draft/Quote orders (skip reservation, skip email)
   - Gift wrap + shipping method (standard/express/same_day/pickup)
   - Internal vs customer note separation
   - Admin-create order flow (POS-style with customer picker, catalog picker, voucher validation)
   - Inventory hooks tied to order lifecycle (reserve on confirmed, commit on shipping, release on cancel)
   - Voucher validation with percent/amount/shipping types
   - Serialize pattern converting Prisma BigInt → number + snake_case
   - Zod `.strict()` on all request bodies

3. Files and Code Sections:

   **`api/prisma/schema.prisma`** (multiple edits — schema extensions):
   - Added `avgCost BigInt?`, `reserved Int @default(0)` to Product & ProductVariant
   - Extended `InventoryReason` enum: added `reserve, release, receive, count, promo`
   - Added to `InventoryMovement`: `unitCost BigInt?`, `refType String?`, `refId String?` + new indexes on `reason,createdAt` and `refType,refId`
   - New enums: `LoyaltyTier` (bronze/silver/gold/platinum), `CustomerSegment` (new_cus/active/vip/at_risk/churn/blacklist), `ShippingMethod` (standard/express/same_day/pickup), `OrderSource` (web/admin/pos/phone/zalo/fb/tiktok/marketplace)
   - Extended `Customer`: added `gender`, `consentEmail/Sms/Call + consentUpdatedAt`, `loyaltyTier/Points`, `totalSpent`, `orderCount`, `lastOrderAt`, `segment`, `source`
   - Extended `CustomerAddress`: added `label`, `recipientName`, `recipientPhone`, `isBilling`
   - New model `CustomerCommunication`: id/customerId/channel/direction/subject/body/outcome/actorId/actorEmail/refType/refId/createdAt
   - Extended `OrderStatus` enum: added `draft`, `quote`
   - Extended `Order`: added `giftWrapFee`, `internalNote`, `shippingMethod`, `giftWrap`, `giftMessage`, `source`, `channel`, `reservedAt`, `pointsEarned`, `pointsUsed`

   **`api/src/inventory/reservation.ts`** (new file) — core reservation service:
   ```ts
   export interface InventoryLineRef {
     productId: string; variantId?: string | null; qty: number;
     orderId?: string; orderItemId?: string;
   }
   export async function reserveStock(lines, actorId, tx = prisma): Promise<void>  // check available, increment reserved, log movement reason='reserve'
   export async function releaseStock(lines, actorId, tx = prisma): Promise<void>  // decrement reserved, log reason='release'
   export async function commitStock(lines, actorId, tx = prisma): Promise<void>   // stock -= qty, reserved -= qty, reason='sale'
   export async function receiveStock(args: {productId, variantId?, qty, unitCost: bigint, note?, refType?, refId?, actorId?}, tx = prisma): Promise<void>
   // receiveStock computes moving-average: newAvg = (oldStock*oldAvg + qty*unitCost) / (oldStock+qty)
   ```

   **`api/src/customers/loyalty.ts`** (new file) — loyalty & RFM:
   ```ts
   export const POINTS_PER_VND = 10_000n;
   export const POINTS_VALUE_VND = 1_000n;
   export const MAX_POINTS_DISCOUNT_PCT = 20;
   export function computeTier(totalSpent: bigint): 'bronze'|'silver'|'gold'|'platinum'
     // thresholds: 2M → silver, 10M → gold, 50M → platinum
   export function computeSegment({createdAt, orderCount, totalSpent, lastOrderAt, currentSegment?}): 'new_cus'|'active'|'vip'|'at_risk'|'churn'
     // vip: totalSpent >= 10M OR orderCount >= 10
     // churn: daysSinceOrder > 180
     // at_risk: daysSinceOrder > 60 && orderCount >= 2
     // new_cus: daysSinceCreate <= 30 && orderCount <= 1
   export function pointsEarnedFor(orderTotal: bigint): number
   export async function recomputeCustomer(customerId, tx = prisma): Promise<void>
     // loads delivered orders, computes totalSpent/orderCount/lastOrderAt, updates tier + segment + points
     // skips if segment==='blacklist'
   export async function recomputeAll(batchSize=200): Promise<{total: number}>
   ```

   **`api/src/routes/inventory.ts`** (extended):
   - Updated `ListQuery`: added `sort` (updated-desc/stock-asc/stock-desc/reserved-desc) and `state: 'reserved'`
   - New schemas: `ReceiveBody`, `ReceiveBulkBody`, `CountBody`
   - Updated `mapReason` to support all new enum values
   - GET /inventory — now returns reserved/available/inventory_value per product + summary totals
   - GET /inventory/alerts — new, lists out + low stock items
   - POST /inventory/receive — single-line PO receive, uses `receiveStock()`
   - POST /inventory/receive-bulk — multi-line PO
   - POST /inventory/count — physical count, creates delta movement
   - Enhanced GET /inventory/movements with reason/refType/date filters + pagination + product/variant join

   **`api/src/routes/orders.ts`** (full rewrite):
   - `ORDER_STATUSES` includes draft/quote
   - `TRANSITIONS`: draft → quote/pending/cancelled; quote → pending/cancelled; rest same
   - `AddressSchema`: added `recipientName`, `recipientPhone`
   - `OrderCreateBody`: added shippingMethod, giftWrap, giftWrapFee, giftMessage, internalNote, source, channel, pointsUsed, status
   - `AdminCreateBody = OrderCreateBody.omit({source}).extend({customer: CustomerInlineSchema.optional(), saveAsAddress: boolean})`
   - `applyVoucher(code, subtotal, shippingFee, tx)` helper — validates voucher (status/dates/minOrder/usageLimit), returns {discount, voucher, error}
   - POST /orders/admin-create:
     - Upserts customer (inline create if not exists by phone/email)
     - Saves address to CustomerAddress if `saveAsAddress`
     - Enriches items with catalog price if priceUnit=0
     - Applies voucher (takes max of manual discount vs voucher)
     - Generates order code, creates order + items + event, increments voucher.usedCount
     - Emails confirmation only if status === 'pending' (skips draft/quote)
   - PATCH /orders/:id/status — inventory hooks:
     - confirmed: `reserveStock(lines)` + sets reservedAt
     - shipping: `commitStock(lines)` (if reservedAt set)
     - cancelled: `releaseStock(lines)` (if reservedAt && !shippedAt)
     - delivered: sets pointsEarned = pointsEarnedFor(total)
     - After tx: fire `recomputeCustomer(customerId)` for delivered/cancelled
   - POST /orders/validate-voucher — preview endpoint for FE

   **`api/src/routes/customers.ts`** (full rewrite):
   - ListQuery: adds segment, tier, consentEmail, source, last-order sort
   - Sort now done at DB level (orderBy direct) instead of in-memory
   - Summary includes `segments: {new_cus: N, vip: N, ...}` groupBy
   - `AddressSchema`: label, recipientName, recipientPhone, isBilling
   - `ConsentSchema`, `CommunicationBody`, `ImportBody`, `MergeBody`, `PointsBody` schemas
   - GET /customers/:id — returns `recent_orders[20]` + `communications[50]`
   - POST/PATCH/DELETE /customers/:id/addresses[/:addrId]
   - GET /customers/:id/communications, POST /customers/:id/communications
   - PATCH /customers/:id/consent — shortcut for consent fields + updates consentUpdatedAt + audit
   - POST /customers/:id/recompute-loyalty, POST /customers/recompute-all
   - POST /customers/:id/points — manual adjust (logs as communication + audit)
   - POST /customers/import — upsert/skip/overwrite strategies, dedup by email/phone
   - POST /customers/merge — moves addresses/orders/communications, unions tags, soft-deletes secondary

   **`admin-orders.html`** (FE — modal added, JS pending):
   - Inserted `<div class="adm-modal" id="ordCreateModal">` before drawer with:
     - 2-column `.create-grid` (customer/items/notes on left, address/shipping/payment/voucher/gift/status/summary on right)
     - Customer picker: search input + results dropdown + "khách mới" toggle + selected display with tier pill
     - Product picker: search + results dropdown + item table with qty controls
     - Address form with collapsible `<details>` for alternate recipient
     - Shipping method select (standard/express/same_day/pickup)
     - Channel select (phone/zalo/fb/tiktok/pos/marketplace)
     - Voucher input + "Kiểm tra" button + status line
     - Gift wrap checkbox with conditional gift message textarea
     - Status radio group (draft/quote/pending)
     - Live summary box with subtotal/discount/shipping/gift/total
     - Submit button `#ocSubmit` (JS not yet wired — handler still uses prompts)
   - Kept existing `btnOrderCreate` prompt-based handler intact — needs replacement

4. Errors and fixes:
   - **TypeScript return type inconsistency in `verifyAndApply`** (from previous session):
     - Fix: Added explicit `VerifyAndApplyResult` interface with `alreadyApplied: boolean` on all 5 return paths
     - Added `PaymentRow`/`OrderRow` helper types
     - Removed unused `PaymentIntentStatus` import
     - Fixed `kind: kind === 'return' ? 'webhook' : 'webhook'` → `'return' : 'webhook'`
   - **Shipping service `applyWebhook` inconsistent shapes** (4 branches):

   - **Docker daemon not running** when user asked for demo link:
     - Fix: Served static FE only via `python3 -m http.server 8080` — documented BE setup steps in response
   - No new errors in the current Inventory/Customers/Orders work.

Skipped: multi-warehouse, lot/expiry, partial-shipment, payment-split (deferred).

The demo server is still running. Let me summarize the work done in this continuation:

## Hoàn thành 3 module vận hành chuẩn chuyên gia

### 🛒 Admin Orders — `admin-orders.html`
Đã thay prompt-based `btnOrderCreate` handler bằng **modal tạo đơn POS-style** với:
- Tìm KH debounced (tên/SĐT/email) hoặc tích "Khách mới" nhập tay + hiển thị tier pill (VIP highlight)
- Picker sản phẩm từ catalog `DTX_ADMIN.all()`, bảng item có ± qty + xoá
- Chọn phương thức giao (standard/express/same_day/pickup) → auto fee 30k/55k/85k/0
- Kênh nguồn (phone/zalo/fb/tiktok/pos/marketplace), PTTT (COD/CK/VNPay/MoMo)
- Voucher check real-time: validate status/ngày/minOrder/usageLimit, áp dụng percent/amount/shipping
- Gói quà 20k + lời nhắn, ghi chú khách + ghi chú nội bộ tách riêng
- 3 trạng thái tạo: **Nháp / Báo giá / Chờ xác nhận**
- Summary box live: subtotal − discount + shipping + gift = total
- Submit: auto-upsert khách mới (dedup theo phone/email), tăng usedCount voucher, tạo order

### 👤 Admin Customers — `admin-customers.html`
Rewrite hoàn toàn, thêm **drawer chi tiết với 6 tab**:
- **Info**: họ tên/giới tính/email/SĐT/DOB/tỉnh/tags/nguồn/ghi chú
- **Địa chỉ**: sổ địa chỉ đa dòng, CRUD, đặt mặc định, đánh dấu billing, người nhận khác
- **Đơn hàng**: timeline 50 đơn gần nhất + tổng chi tiêu thực nhận
- **Liên lạc**: timeline email/SMS/call/chat/note, thêm mới với hướng in/out, actor + timestamp
- **Loyalty**: tier pill (Đồng/Bạc/Vàng/Bạch kim), điểm, progress bar đến hạng kế tiếp, manual adjust ±điểm, nút recompute tier+segment
- **Đồng ý**: toggle Email/SMS/Call với audit `consentUpdatedAt`, override segment + status

Thêm: **Import CSV modal** (upsert/skip/overwrite, dedup email/phone), filter segment + tier, stat VIP/churn/CLV.

### 📦 Admin Inventory — `admin-inventory.html`
Rewrite với model kho chuyên nghiệp:
- 3 tab: Tất cả / Cảnh báo (hết + thấp) / Đang giữ
- Cột mới: **Tồn / Giữ / Khả dụng / Giá vốn TB**, summary Giá trị tồn kho
- **Modal nhập kho PO**: search SP → thêm dòng → qty + đơn giá → moving-average cost auto-compute, lưu refType=`purchase_order`
- **Modal kiểm kê vật lý**: input số đếm thực, hiển thị delta live, apply tạo movement `count`
- **Drawer lịch sử movement**: lọc theo lý do (receive/sale/adjust/reserve/release/count) + khoảng ngày, join tên SP + actor + ref

### Bổ trợ
- `assets/admin-data.js`: product normalizer thêm `reserved`, `avgCost`
- `assets/admin-data-ext.js`: 
  - Customer normalizer mở rộng 10+ field mới (consent/loyalty/segment/communications)
  - `Customers.computeTier/computeSegment/addCommunication/findOrdersFor`
  - `Inventory.receive/receiveBulk/count/reserve/release/alerts` + Movements ledger (2k entries cap)
- `assets/admin.css`: +500 dòng cho drawer/tabs/tier-pills/comm-timeline/loyalty-box/inv-tabs/stock-adjust

Demo vẫn chạy ở http://localhost:8080 — mở `admin-orders.html`, `admin-customers.html`, `admin-inventory.html` để test.

# Audit báo cáo go-live — detoxblanc OMS

## 1. Thiếu sót quan trọng (MUST-FIX trước go-live)

### FE-BE wiring chưa hoàn chỉnh (P0 — khối lớn nhất)
- **`assets/admin-api.js` thiếu nhiều bridge admin trọng yếu**. Trong remote stores (dòng 269-307, 369-379) chỉ có CRUD chuẩn cho orders/customers + inventory `adjust/set/movements/overview`. Chưa có:
  - `POST /orders/admin-create` — `admin-orders.html:904` đang gọi `S.create(orderPayload)` (CRUD thường, KHÔNG đi qua endpoint POS có reserveStock + voucher usedCount). **Tạo đơn POS sẽ bypass logic phía BE.**
  - `POST /customers/:id/recompute-loyalty`, `POST /customers/:id/communications`, `GET /customers/:id/communications`, `PATCH /customers/:id/consent`, `POST /customers/:id/addresses` (+ PUT/DELETE), `POST /customers/:id/loyalty-adjust`, `POST /customers/merge`. Drawer 6 tab về thực chất sẽ chỉ chạy trên local store.
  - `POST /inventory/receive`, `/inventory/receive-bulk`, `/inventory/count`, `GET /inventory/alerts`. `admin-inventory.html` modal Nhập kho PO + Kiểm kê chưa có cách nào gọi BE thật.
- **Customer page lấy data qua `S.all()`** (`admin-customers.html:176`) — remote store generic không cache list các sub-resource (communications, addresses), nên các tab drawer rỗng dữ liệu khi chuyển sang remote.

### Auth/permission FE
- BE đã `requirePermission('orders:write' | 'customers:write' | 'inventory:write')` đầy đủ (xác nhận ở `routes/orders.ts:303,410,592`, `routes/customers.ts`, `routes/inventory.ts`).
- **FE 3 file HTML chưa có hide button theo permission**. Không tìm thấy bất kỳ check `hasPermission`/`canAccess` nào trong `admin-orders.html`, `admin-customers.html`, `admin-inventory.html`. Người dùng không quyền vẫn thấy nút "Tạo đơn", "Nhập kho", "Recompute", click → BE trả 403 nhưng UX khó chịu và lộ chức năng.

### Migrations & seed
- **KHÔNG có thư mục `api/prisma/migrations/`**. Chỉ có `schema.prisma`. Trường mới (`reserved`, `avgCost`, `segment`, `loyaltyTier`, `loyaltyPoints`, `consentEmail/Sms/Call`, model `Communication`, `InventoryMovement`, `pointsEarned`, `reservedAt`, …) chưa có migration SQL chính thức. Chạy `prisma migrate dev` sẽ tự sinh nhưng phải làm trước go-live, kèm seed phong phú hơn.

### Race conditions / data integrity
- `reserveStock`/`commitStock`/`releaseStock` đã trong `$transaction` (orders.ts:598, 706). Tốt.
- Voucher `usedCount` tăng cũng nằm trong cùng transaction (orders.ts:367-375, 550-555). Tốt.
- `admin-create` rollback đúng (toàn bộ trong transaction, throw → rollback).
- **BUG quan trọng `commitStock` khi không có variantId** (`api/src/inventory/reservation.ts:135-140`): chỉ trừ `reserved`, **không trừ `stock` của Product**. Có nghĩa product không variant sẽ không bao giờ giảm tồn vật lý khi ship.
- **BUG `receiveStock` không variantId** (line 190-192): chỉ ghi movement, không update product stock. PO cho SP single (no-variant) sẽ không tăng tồn.
- Stock check trong `reserveStock` đọc `findUnique` rồi `update` — không lock; concurrent reserve có thể oversell. Nên dùng `update where stock-reserved>=qty` atomic, hoặc `SELECT … FOR UPDATE`.

### Edge cases vận hành chưa cover
- **Không có route returns/refund** (chỉ có status `returned` trong TRANSITIONS nhưng không có handler trả lại stock, refund payment, sinh RMA).
- **Cancel sau shipping** không được phép (`TRANSITIONS.shipping = ['delivered']`). Khi giao thất bại / khách bom hàng thì không có path quay về.
- Không có flow partial-shipment, không có route gắn `trackingCode` (BE có field nhưng không endpoint).
- Loyalty `pointsEarned` chỉ ghi 1 chiều khi delivered; cancel/return sau khi đã earn KHÔNG hoàn điểm.

---

## 2. UX/Layout có thể vỡ khi nhập dữ liệu thật

- **Bảng `.adm-tbl`** (`admin.css:667-685`) không có `table-layout:fixed`, các `td` không có `max-width`/`text-overflow`. Tên SP/KH dài sẽ đẩy ngang → tràn `.card` (card không có `overflow-x:auto`). Đặc biệt `inventory` 10 cột tại 1366px chắc chắn vỡ.
- **`.pr-cell` `min-width:280px`** trong table 10 cột → tổng min ≈ 1100-1300px, nén cột phải hoặc tràn.
- **Drawer customer** `width:min(760px,100%)` (`admin.css:1450`). Communication body 2000 ký tự — `.comm-list` không có `word-break:break-word`/`white-space:pre-wrap` rõ ràng (chỉ `.kv-grid dd` có `word-break:break-word`), email/URL dài sẽ phá layout.
- **Modal create-order** `adm-modal-lg width:min(1120px,100%)` + `max-height:90vh` nhưng body 2 cột picker khách + sản phẩm + form ship + voucher + items table → trên 1366×768 (viewport hữu dụng ~640px sau header), inner sẽ **scroll cả modal**, không scroll riêng panel; UX kém. Nên đặt `.adm-modal-body{overflow:auto}` hoặc tách 2 cột thành sticky.
- **Email/voucher dài**: input `maxlength=120/30` ổn, nhưng cell hiển thị danh sách không truncate — tên KH 120 ký tự sẽ phá row.

---

## 3. Tính năng vận hành cần (NICE-TO-HAVE)

| # | Tính năng | Ưu tiên |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | RMA/Returns flow đầy đủ (return → release stock + refund + restock movement) | **P0** |
| 2 | Gắn `trackingCode` + carrier (GHN/Viettel Post) + webhook update | **P0** |
| 3 | Cancel-after-shipping flow (lost/refused) trả tồn | **P0** |
| 4 | In nhãn ship + invoice VAT (PDF) | P1 |
| 5 | Partial shipment (1 đơn 2 kiện) | P1 |
| 6 | Multi-warehouse / location-based stock | P1 |
| 7 | Lot/expiry tracking (mỹ phẩm cần date hết hạn) | P1 |
| 8 | Payment-split (đặt cọc + thanh toán phần còn lại) | P1 |
| 9 | COD ledger reconciliation (đối soát với GHN) | P1 |
| 10 | Refund partial + hoàn điểm loyalty | P2 |

---

## 4. Rollout plan

### Giai đoạn 0 — Chuẩn bị (2-3 ngày)
- Tạo `prisma migrate dev --name oms_v1` rồi `migrate deploy` lên staging; review SQL bằng tay (đặc biệt `Customer`, `Product.reserved`, `InventoryMovement` indexes).
- Hoàn thiện 13 bridge thiếu trong `assets/admin-api.js` (ưu tiên: `adminCreate`, `recomputeLoyalty`, `communications`, `consent`, `addresses`, `receive`, `count`, `alerts`).
- Sửa 2 bug `commitStock`/`receiveStock` không variantId.
- Thêm `requirePermission` check ở FE (hide button + disable form) trong 3 trang admin.
- Seed phong phú: 200 SP có variants, 500 KH đa segment, 5000 movement, voucher đủ kiểu.
- Smoke test: create order admin → confirm → ship → deliver, voucher used++, loyalty earn.

### Giai đoạn 1 — UAT nội bộ (1 tuần)
- Tester: 1 PO + 2 ops + 1 dev. Kịch bản:
  1. Tạo 30 đơn POS (gồm voucher hết, voucher percent/amount/shipping, KH mới, KH cũ).
  2. Reserve → cancel → re-reserve cùng SKU 5 lần (kiểm tra reserved không lệch).
  3. Nhập kho PO 10 SKU, kiểm kê chênh lệch âm/dương.
  4. Drawer KH: ghi 50 communication, đổi consent, recompute loyalty.
  5. Concurrent: 2 admin tạo đơn cùng 1 SKU sắp hết.
- Exit criteria: 0 P0 bug, < 5 P1 bug, reserved/stock chính xác, audit log đầy đủ.

### Giai đoạn 2 — Pilot 1 team (2 tuần)
- 1 nhóm CSKH/ops thật vận hành 100% qua admin mới, chạy song song hệ cũ chỉ-đọc.
- Metrics theo dõi (Grafana/log): orders/day, error rate `/orders/admin-create` < 1%, p95 latency < 500ms, sai lệch tồn cuối ngày = 0, `voucher.usedCount` khớp số lần áp dụng, loyalty point delta khớp `pointsEarnedFor`.
- Daily standup 15' review log + bug.

### Giai đoạn 3 — Full go-live
- Ngắt cắm hệ cũ, switch DNS / mode `remote` ở `admin-api.js`.
- Rollback plan: feature flag `DTX_API_MODE=local` để fallback FE; DB rollback bằng `prisma migrate resolve` về migration trước + restore Postgres snapshot (chụp ngay trước cutover); BullMQ pause → drain. Window rollback 24 h.
- Backup mỗi 1 h trong tuần đầu; on-call dev 2 ca.

---

**Findings ngắn (file path tương đối)**:
- `assets/admin-api.js` — thiếu 10+ bridge admin
- `admin-orders.html:904` — gọi nhầm `S.create` thay vì `adminCreate`
- `api/src/inventory/reservation.ts:135-192` — 2 bug khi không có variantId
- `api/src/routes/orders.ts:29-42` — TRANSITIONS thiếu nhánh cancel-after-ship, không có refund/return handler
- `api/prisma/migrations/` — không tồn tại
- `assets/admin.css:667-685` — `.adm-tbl` không truncate, table 10 cột sẽ vỡ ở 1366px
- 3 file HTML — không hide UI theo permission

- **Customer page lấy data qua `S.all()`** (`admin-customers.html:176`) — remote store generic không cache list các sub-resource (communications, addresses), nên các tab drawer rỗng dữ liệu khi chuyển sang remote.

### Auth/permission FE
- BE đã `requirePermission('orders:write' | 'customers:write' | 'inventory:write')` đầy đủ (xác nhận ở `routes/orders.ts:303,410,592`, `routes/customers.ts`, `routes/inventory.ts`).
- **FE 3 file HTML chưa có hide button theo permission**. Không tìm thấy bất kỳ check `hasPermission`/`canAccess` nào trong `admin-orders.html`, `admin-customers.html`, `admin-inventory.html`. Người dùng không quyền vẫn thấy nút "Tạo đơn", "Nhập kho", "Recompute", click → BE trả 403 nhưng UX khó chịu và lộ chức năng.

### Migrations & seed
- **KHÔNG có thư mục `api/prisma/migrations/`**. Chỉ có `schema.prisma`. Trường mới (`reserved`, `avgCost`, `segment`, `loyaltyTier`, `loyaltyPoints`, `consentEmail/Sms/Call`, model `Communication`, `InventoryMovement`, `pointsEarned`, `reservedAt`, …) chưa có migration SQL chính thức. Chạy `prisma migrate dev` sẽ tự sinh nhưng phải làm trước go-live, kèm seed phong phú hơn.

### Race conditions / data integrity
- `reserveStock`/`commitStock`/`releaseStock` đã trong `$transaction` (orders.ts:598, 706). Tốt.
- Voucher `usedCount` tăng cũng nằm trong cùng transaction (orders.ts:367-375, 550-555). Tốt.
- `admin-create` rollback đúng (toàn bộ trong transaction, throw → rollback).
- **BUG quan trọng `commitStock` khi không có variantId** (`api/src/inventory/reservation.ts:135-140`): chỉ trừ `reserved`, **không trừ `stock` của Product**. Có nghĩa product không variant sẽ không bao giờ giảm tồn vật lý khi ship.
- **BUG `receiveStock` không variantId** (line 190-192): chỉ ghi movement, không update product stock. PO cho SP single (no-variant) sẽ không tăng tồn.
- Stock check trong `reserveStock` đọc `findUnique` rồi `update` — không lock; concurrent reserve có thể oversell. Nên dùng `update where stock-reserved>=qty` atomic, hoặc `SELECT … FOR UPDATE`.

### Edge cases vận hành chưa cover
- **Không có route returns/refund** (chỉ có status `returned` trong TRANSITIONS nhưng không có handler trả lại stock, refund payment, sinh RMA).
- **Cancel sau shipping** không được phép (`TRANSITIONS.shipping = ['delivered']`). Khi giao thất bại / khách bom hàng thì không có path quay về.
- Không có flow partial-shipment, không có route gắn `trackingCode` (BE có field nhưng không endpoint).
- Loyalty `pointsEarned` chỉ ghi 1 chiều khi delivered; cancel/return sau khi đã earn KHÔNG hoàn điểm.

---

## 2. UX/Layout có thể vỡ khi nhập dữ liệu thật

- **Bảng `.adm-tbl`** (`admin.css:667-685`) không có `table-layout:fixed`, các `td` không có `max-width`/`text-overflow`. Tên SP/KH dài sẽ đẩy ngang → tràn `.card` (card không có `overflow-x:auto`). Đặc biệt `inventory` 10 cột tại 1366px chắc chắn vỡ.
- **`.pr-cell` `min-width:280px`** trong table 10 cột → tổng min ≈ 1100-1300px, nén cột phải hoặc tràn.
- **Drawer customer** `width:min(760px,100%)` (`admin.css:1450`). Communication body 2000 ký tự — `.comm-list` không có `word-break:break-word`/`white-space:pre-wrap` rõ ràng (chỉ `.kv-grid dd` có `word-break:break-word`), email/URL dài sẽ phá layout.
- **Modal create-order** `adm-modal-lg width:min(1120px,100%)` + `max-height:90vh` nhưng body 2 cột picker khách + sản phẩm + form ship + voucher + items table → trên 1366×768 (viewport hữu dụng ~640px sau header), inner sẽ **scroll cả modal**, không scroll riêng panel; UX kém. Nên đặt `.adm-modal-body{overflow:auto}` hoặc tách 2 cột thành sticky.
- **Email/voucher dài**: input `maxlength=120/30` ổn, nhưng cell hiển thị danh sách không truncate — tên KH 120 ký tự sẽ phá row.

---

## 3. Tính năng vận hành cần (NICE-TO-HAVE)

| # | Tính năng | Ưu tiên |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | RMA/Returns flow đầy đủ (return → release stock + refund + restock movement) | **P0** |
| 2 | Gắn `trackingCode` + carrier (GHN/Viettel Post) + webhook update | **P0** |
| 3 | Cancel-after-shipping flow (lost/refused) trả tồn | **P0** |
| 4 | In nhãn ship + invoice VAT (PDF) | P1 |
| 5 | Partial shipment (1 đơn 2 kiện) | P1 |
| 6 | Multi-warehouse / location-based stock | P1 |
| 7 | Lot/expiry tracking (mỹ phẩm cần date hết hạn) | P1 |
| 8 | Payment-split (đặt cọc + thanh toán phần còn lại) | P1 |
| 9 | COD ledger reconciliation (đối soát với GHN) | P1 |
| 10 | Refund partial + hoàn điểm loyalty | P2 |

---

## 4. Rollout plan

### Giai đoạn 0 — Chuẩn bị (2-3 ngày)
- Tạo `prisma migrate dev --name oms_v1` rồi `migrate deploy` lên staging; review SQL bằng tay (đặc biệt `Customer`, `Product.reserved`, `InventoryMovement` indexes).
- Hoàn thiện 13 bridge thiếu trong `assets/admin-api.js` (ưu tiên: `adminCreate`, `recomputeLoyalty`, `communications`, `consent`, `addresses`, `receive`, `count`, `alerts`).
- Sửa 2 bug `commitStock`/`receiveStock` không variantId.
- Thêm `requirePermission` check ở FE (hide button + disable form) trong 3 trang admin.
- Seed phong phú: 200 SP có variants, 500 KH đa segment, 5000 movement, voucher đủ kiểu.
- Smoke test: create order admin → confirm → ship → deliver, voucher used++, loyalty earn.

### Giai đoạn 1 — UAT nội bộ (1 tuần)
- Tester: 1 PO + 2 ops + 1 dev. Kịch bản:
  1. Tạo 30 đơn POS (gồm voucher hết, voucher percent/amount/shipping, KH mới, KH cũ).
  2. Reserve → cancel → re-reserve cùng SKU 5 lần (kiểm tra reserved không lệch).
  3. Nhập kho PO 10 SKU, kiểm kê chênh lệch âm/dương.
  4. Drawer KH: ghi 50 communication, đổi consent, recompute loyalty.
  5. Concurrent: 2 admin tạo đơn cùng 1 SKU sắp hết.
- Exit criteria: 0 P0 bug, < 5 P1 bug, reserved/stock chính xác, audit log đầy đủ.

### Giai đoạn 2 — Pilot 1 team (2 tuần)
- 1 nhóm CSKH/ops thật vận hành 100% qua admin mới, chạy song song hệ cũ chỉ-đọc.
- Metrics theo dõi (Grafana/log): orders/day, error rate `/orders/admin-create` < 1%, p95 latency < 500ms, sai lệch tồn cuối ngày = 0, `voucher.usedCount` khớp số lần áp dụng, loyalty point delta khớp `pointsEarnedFor`.
- Daily standup 15' review log + bug.

### Giai đoạn 3 — Full go-live
- Ngắt cắm hệ cũ, switch DNS / mode `remote` ở `admin-api.js`.
- Rollback plan: feature flag `DTX_API_MODE=local` để fallback FE; DB rollback bằng `prisma migrate resolve` về migration trước + restore Postgres snapshot (chụp ngay trước cutover); BullMQ pause → drain. Window rollback 24 h.
- Backup mỗi 1 h trong tuần đầu; on-call dev 2 ca.

---

- `api/src/inventory/reservation.ts:135-192` — 2 bug khi không có variantId

- `assets/admin.css:667-685` — `.adm-tbl` không truncate, table 10 cột sẽ vỡ ở 1366px
- 3 file HTML — không hide UI theo permission

# Detoxblanc OMS — Production Readiness Checklist

> Tài liệu này là cẩm nang để chuyển hệ thống từ DEV → STAGING → PROD an toàn.
> Mỗi mục có chủ thể, tiêu chí Done, và lệnh thực thi nếu áp dụng.

---

## 0. Bản tóm tắt scope hiện tại (đã có)

- ✅ FE: `admin-orders.html`, `admin-customers.html`, `admin-inventory.html` với 3 modal/drawer chính.
- ✅ BE: `api/src/routes/{orders,customers,inventory}.ts` với tất cả endpoint chính + reservation/loyalty service.
- ✅ Prisma schema mở rộng (reserved, avgCost, loyaltyTier, segment, communications, …).
- ✅ Layout guards CSS chống vỡ bố cục khi admin nhập dữ liệu thật (table truncate, modal scroll, word-break).
- ❌ Một số P0 chưa fix (xem mục 1 bên dưới).

---

## 1. CHECKLIST P0 — bắt buộc trước go-live

### 1.1 Sửa bug logic kho

| # | Mô tả | File | Done |
|---|---|---|---|
| ☐ | `commitStock` không trừ `Product.stock` khi SP không có variantId | `api/src/inventory/reservation.ts` | |
| ☐ | `receiveStock` không cộng `Product.stock` khi SP không có variantId | `api/src/inventory/reservation.ts` | |
| ☐ | `reserveStock` đổi sang atomic conditional update (`UPDATE … WHERE stock-reserved>=qty`) chống oversell | `api/src/inventory/reservation.ts` | |

### 1.2 Bổ sung route nghiệp vụ thiếu

| # | Endpoint | File | Done |
|---|---|---|---|
| ☐ | `POST /orders/:id/return` — sinh RMA, trả lại stock, refund toàn phần/một phần | `api/src/routes/orders.ts` | |
| ☐ | `POST /orders/:id/cancel-after-ship` — đơn lost/refused, trả tồn từ committed | `api/src/routes/orders.ts` | |
| ☐ | `PATCH /orders/:id/tracking` — gắn carrier + tracking code | `api/src/routes/orders.ts` | |
| ☐ | Hoàn `loyaltyPoints` trong `recomputeCustomer` khi cancel/return sau delivered | `api/src/customers/loyalty.ts` | |

### 1.3 FE-BE bridge (bắt buộc khi switch sang remote mode)

Trong `assets/admin-api.js` thêm:

```js
DTX_ADMIN_ORDERS.adminCreate(payload)        // POST /orders/admin-create
DTX_ADMIN_ORDERS.return(id, payload)         // POST /orders/:id/return
DTX_ADMIN_ORDERS.tracking(id, payload)       // PATCH /orders/:id/tracking
DTX_ADMIN_ORDERS.validateVoucher(payload)    // POST /orders/validate-voucher

DTX_ADMIN_CUSTOMERS.recomputeLoyalty(id)     // POST /customers/:id/recompute-loyalty
DTX_ADMIN_CUSTOMERS.addCommunication(id, x)  // POST /customers/:id/communications
DTX_ADMIN_CUSTOMERS.listCommunications(id)   // GET  /customers/:id/communications
```
